tags.chapter_name: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties

question.text: The first ionization energy of magnesium is smaller, as compared to that of elements <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">X</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">Y</mi></math>, but higher than that of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">Z</mi></math>. The elements <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">X</mi><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">Y</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">Z</mi></math>, respectively, are :

solution.text:
The 1st IE order of 3rd period is

Na<Al<Mg<Si<S<P<Cl<Ar

X & Y are Ar & Cl

Z is sodium (Na).
